bio: Archetype: Multi-use Buff/Debuff, Cleanse, Empower Incantation. ⌽ Inflicts numerous random buffs and debuffs. Improves team damage and survivability. ⌽ Insight 3 passively provides a random buff to all allies at the start of every turn. ⌽ Gains [Eureka] when an ally has 4+ buffs; works well with characters who can self-buff. ⌽ Skill 1 inflicts random debuffs and grants [Eureka] if holding 4 or less. ⌽ Skill 2 applies random buffs and cleanses a single ally. ⌽ Consumes [Eureka] to strengthen own Ultimate or grant [Empower Incantation I] through S2.
